homeBrowser.title: Your home
homeBrowser.subtitle: Your Home Assistant rooms and devices. Choose what to share.
homeBrowser.roomNote: Rooms and device names come from Home Assistant. Nothing to organize twice.
homeBrowser.instructions: Select a device card to include its visible entities. Open its entity list only when you want to fine-tune.
homeBrowser.groupingNote: Cards follow physical Home Assistant devices; independent entities stay separate. Selecting a card does not automatically combine its entities into one Matter endpoint. Use Device bundles when you want composition.
homeBrowser.rules: This hub currently follows sharing rules. You can browse its devices here without changing anything, or switch to a reviewed device selection.
homeBrowser.converting: You are replacing dynamic rules with the entities selected below. Future entities will not be added automatically. Nothing changes until you review and apply.
homeBrowser.standalone: This hub uses standalone device nodes. Browse its inventory here; change standalone sharing in Advanced.

deviceWorkspace.unclassified: Automatic mapping needs inspection. This does not mean the entity is unsupported: plugins, feature flags, and explicit overrides may provide a mapping.
deviceWorkspace.capabilityNote: Capability hints come from HA attributes and built-in mapping guidance, not live controller verification. Controllers may show separate tiles or omit capabilities.
deviceWorkspace.conflict: This device mapping changed elsewhere. Close, reload, and review it again.
deviceWorkspace.stagedSharing: Sharing is staged in Your devices. Apply the sharing selection separately after saving this mapping; no second server write is hidden in this editor.
deviceWorkspace.companionNote: Companions add readings to the primary device; composition adds child endpoints. A filter sensor must report remaining life in %, not filter usage. Clearing a companion allows the hub's automatic mapper to rediscover it.
deviceWorkspace.searchMappings: Search entities, names, types, or overrides

plan.title: Review changes
plan.warning: Sharing removals, type changes, companion edits, and bundling can change device shape and disrupt controller rooms or routines. Removing composition preserves other overrides and frozen identities. Hub-wide automatic composition can still apply; removed children appear separately only if shared by this hub.
plan.snapshot: Create a configuration snapshot before applying
plan.snapshotNote: Snapshots cover hub configuration, not controller rooms or routines. If snapshot creation fails, nothing is applied. A successful snapshot may remain even if the change fails.
plan.approve: I reviewed the changes and their impact
plan.failed: Inspect current configuration before retrying. No automatic retry is performed.

pair.title: Pairing checklist
pair.network: Keep the phone, controller, and hub on a network that permits IPv6 and mDNS multicast. Guest Wi-Fi and VLAN isolation can prevent discovery.
pair.scan: Use the pairing card below. Select Add Matter device in your controller app and scan the QR code or enter the setup code while the commissioning window is open.
pair.multiAdmin: Already paired? Open a new commissioning window for the additional app; do not factory-reset the hub or reuse an expired code.
pair.verify: A connected fabric confirms pairing, not feature parity. Check expected devices and controls. If some are missing, inspect the health inbox and controller guidance.
pair.checksPassed: The reported checks passed. This does not verify end-to-end controller discovery or guarantee pairing.
pair.noChecks: No usable checks were returned. Connectivity has not been verified.
pair.noReset: If pairing times out: refresh checks, confirm the commissioning window is open, verify network isolation and controller support, then retry. Reset only as a last resort: it removes pairings and can disrupt routines.

health.title: Device health
health.description: Review actionable inventory and mapping issues. These are configuration hints, not live controller monitoring; nothing is repaired automatically.
health.ruleBased: This hub uses advanced sharing rules. Inventory checks cover configured mappings and reported failures, not every rule-matched endpoint.
health.missing: Referenced entity missing from Home Assistant
health.clear: No matching issues in the loaded inventory. This is not a guarantee of controller health.

fix.unavailable: Check the source integration in Home Assistant before changing Matter configuration.
fix.failed: Inspect endpoint diagnostics and the error before changing its type.
fix.unclassified: Inspect HA attributes or select an explicit Matter type. Plugins may already support this entity.
fix.conflict: Review each owning mapping; shared companions may be intentional. Avoid absorbing one child into multiple devices.
fix.missing: Restore or replace this entity reference; do not delete frozen identities to fix a missing sensor.
fix.controller: Inspect controller support guidance in Configure. Partial or unknown support is not proof of failure.

bundles.checkAfterFailure: If a request failed after reaching the server, inspect mappings before retrying; no automatic retry is performed.
bundles.removeWarning: Removing {{entity}} clears all of its overrides, including bundles and companion readings. Device shape, app rooms, and routines may change. Frozen identities are not deleted. To remove only a bundle, edit its composed entities instead.
bundles.title: Device bundles
bundles.description: Bring related readings and controls together as a real Matter device, not just a visual group.
bundles.optIn: Nothing changes until you preview and approve a bundle. Composition is enabled for that device only; hub-wide automatic grouping and identity settings stay untouched.
bundles.standalone: Composed bundles require bridge mode. Standalone nodes keep their existing configuration.
bundles.sameDevice: Suggested from Home Assistant device membership and sensor classes. Review the exact capabilities before applying.
bundles.none: No unambiguous, unmapped bundles found. Use a custom device or edit existing mappings.
bundles.name: Device name (optional)
bundles.purifierWarning: This is a fan with related sensors, not a confirmed purifier. Apply only if this device really is an air purifier. If you select a filter sensor, verify it reports remaining life, not usage.
bundles.shareFirst: Share the primary entity in Your devices first. Automatic bundle creation currently requires an explicit entity selection; advanced rule-based hubs can configure composition through mappings.
bundles.pairedWarning: This hub is already paired. These entities will change endpoint shape and composed children will no longer be separate Matter devices. App rooms, assignments, and routines may need repair, and some controllers require re-pairing.
bundles.previewWarning: Composed children become part of the primary device. Mapped companions add readings but may still have separate endpoints if shared individually.
bundles.controllerNote: Controller support is a compatibility guide, not a live test. Apps may show individual capabilities separately, omit them, or require re-pairing. Existing automatic companion mappings may expose other readings.
bundles.approve: I reviewed the entities, controller limitations, and potential pairing changes.
bundles.saved: Mapping saved. The hub will reconcile the endpoint on its next refresh; review Advanced diagnostics for mapping errors.

validation.members: Choose a primary and at least one different additional entity.
validation.missing: A member is missing, hidden, or disabled. Reload the inventory and review the bundle.
validation.unavailable: A member is unavailable or has no known state. Wait for Home Assistant to receive a reading before creating the bundle.
validation.conflict: A member already has a mapping or belongs to another device. Edit that mapping instead; it will not be overwritten.

workspace.configHelp: Expand only what you need. Use JSON for precise control over the same settings.
workspace.advancedCreateWarning: This mode exposes the complete configuration and templates. Empty include rules share every supported entity, not none. Review the filter preview before creating a hub. Alexa pairing requires port 5540.
workspace.advancedDescription: Keep the simple defaults, or tune every detail without leaving your hub.
workspace.lifecycleDescription: Export this hub or use the action menu for force sync, orphan cleanup, factory reset, and deletion. Destructive actions still require confirmation.
workspace.configWarning: Advanced changes can alter existing endpoints or pairing. All existing fields are preserved until you explicitly save.
workspace.configChanged: This hub's configuration changed elsewhere. Reload before saving to avoid overwriting it.
workspace.toolsDescription: Manage your hubs, integrations, and maintenance in one place. Everyday device sharing stays in Your home.

toolDescriptions.hubs: Import, export, and manage hubs together. Open any hub to return to its workspace.
toolDescriptions.endpoints: Search the actual Matter endpoint inventory across every hub, including failures and per-entity overrides.
toolDescriptions.standalone: For devices that need their own Matter node and pairing code. Most homes should use a shared hub.
toolDescriptions.areas: An advanced setup for separate room-based hubs, with assistant profiles and a preview before creation.
toolDescriptions.startup: Control the order your hubs start in. Existing priorities are preserved.
toolDescriptions.network: Inspect controller connections, endpoints, and topology. Layout changes do not regroup devices.
toolDescriptions.credentials: Manage the credentials needed for Home Assistant lock operations.
toolDescriptions.filters: Explore Home Assistant labels, rooms, and registry values for advanced sharing rules.
toolDescriptions.plugins: Install and manage extensions without changing your hub's device selection.
toolDescriptions.health: Check bridge health and connectivity across your home.
toolDescriptions.events: Follow state changes, commands, sessions, and errors as they happen.
toolDescriptions.network-check: Investigate local network and discovery problems.
toolDescriptions.system-info: Inspect runtime and environment details for troubleshooting.
toolDescriptions.backup: Keep a recovery copy before making configuration or pairing changes.
toolDescriptions.recovery: Tune automatic recovery behavior for your installation.
toolDescriptions.access: Control HTTP authentication for this interface.

modern.homeTitle: A home that speaks your language.
modern.homeDescription: Choose what to share. Keep Home Assistant at the center.
modern.welcomeDescription: Bring your Home Assistant devices to Alexa, Apple Home, or Google Home. Start with one hub; add another only when you need it.
modern.failedCount_one: {{count}} entity could not be exposed. Review the details before pairing.
modern.failedCount_other: {{count}} entities could not be exposed. Review the details before pairing.
modern.notPaired: Your hub is not paired yet. Add it in your assistant's app to connect your home.
modern.pairDescription: In your assistant's app, add a Matter device and scan the QR code or enter the setup code. Pair this hub, not each device individually. Availability of device types varies by app.
modern.ruleBased: This hub uses advanced rules or standalone mode. They are preserved exactly as configured. Edit them in Advanced; the simple picker will not replace them.
modern.saved: Sharing updated. Your hub is applying the changes.
modern.missingSelected: These selected entities are no longer in Home Assistant. They stay selected unless you remove them.
modern.compatibilityNote: Selection does not guarantee Matter or app support. Unsupported entities are skipped; mapping failures appear in hub details. Hidden, disabled, and diagnostic entities are omitted unless already selected.
modern.pendingChanges: Changes stay local until you apply them. Removing devices may remove their app assignments and routines.
modern.removeAllWarning: Applying this removes every shared device from this hub. App assignments and routines may be lost.
modern.setupDescription: Choose an assistant and what it can access. We handle the bridge configuration.

controller.apple_home: Connect your home to Apple Home and Siri.
controller.google_home: Connect your home to Google Home.
controller.multi_controller: Use the same hub with more than one app.

modern.oneHubHint: Most homes only need one hub. You can pair it with multiple apps later. The assistant choice applies the existing recommended compatibility settings.
modern.reviewDescription: Only your selection will be shared. New entities are not added automatically. The server assigns a free port; no JSON, templates, or feature flags required.
modern.networkNote: Matter needs a compatible controller and local IPv6/mDNS connectivity. Separate VLANs may need network configuration. No AWS account or router port forwarding is required.
modern.discardMessage: Unsaved device edits or sharing selections will be discarded.
modern.remoteChanged: This hub was changed elsewhere. Reload its selection before applying your changes.

common.name: Name
common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Check clipboard permissions or select and copy the code manually.

standaloneDevices.title: Standalone Devices
standaloneDevices.subtitle: Each device runs on its own Matter node with its own pairing code, instead of inside a bridge.
standaloneDevices.name: Name
standaloneDevices.entityHelp: Pick the Home Assistant entity to expose.
standaloneDevices.multiHint: The first entity is the primary and names the device. More than one entity per device is experimental.
standaloneDevices.empty: No standalone devices yet. Add one to expose a single entity as its own Matter device.
standaloneDevices.entityInvalid: Enter a single entity id like vacuum.living_room, wildcards are not allowed.
standaloneDevices.confirmDeleteMessage: This deletes the device's Matter node and unpairs it from your controllers. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings

recovery.title: Auto recovery
recovery.hint: Periodically restarts bridges that failed to start. Only failed bridges are touched.

settings.disableAuthMessage: This will remove password protection from the web UI. Anyone on your network will be able to access and modify your bridge configuration.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome to Home Assistant Matter Hub
dashboard.welcomeDescription: Bridge your Home Assistant devices to Matter controllers like Apple Home, Google Home, and Amazon Alexa.
dashboard.successMessage: Your bridges are connected to {{count}} controller fabric(s). Devices should now appear in your controller app.
dashboard.noBridgesHint: No bridges configured yet. Use the Bridge Wizard or create one manually.

bridge.name: Bridge Name
bridge.pairHint: Pair this bridge with your controller
bridge.pairDescription: Open your controller app (Apple Home, Google Home, or Amazon Alexa), add a new accessory, and scan the QR code below or enter the manual pairing code. Make sure your controller is on the same network as Home Assistant.
bridge.serverModeRecommended: Server Mode Recommended for Robot Vacuums
bridge.serverModeDescription: This bridge contains a robot vacuum in bridged mode. Apple Home and Alexa will show the bridge as an additional device, resulting in duplicate entries. Enable Server Mode to expose the vacuum as a standalone Matter device for full Siri/Alexa voice command support and no duplicates.
bridge.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this bridge?
bridge.refreshHint: New devices and changes on labels are discovered every 30 seconds.
bridge.serverModeSingleDeviceNote: Note: Server Mode requires the vacuum to be the only device on this bridge. Please remove other entities from this bridge first, then enable Server Mode in the bridge settings.
bridge.serverModeEnabled: Server Mode enabled. The bridge will restart with your vacuum as a standalone device.
bridge.fabricTooltip: A fabric represents a connection to a Matter controller (e.g., Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa). Each controller creates one fabric when paired.
bridge.forceSyncTooltip: Push all current device states to connected controllers
bridge.bridgeNotRunning: Bridge is not running. Start the bridge to see pairing information.
bridge.noFabrics: No controllers connected yet. Scan the QR code with your Matter controller to pair this bridge.
bridge.noFilters: No filters configured. All supported entities will be exposed.
bridge.scanQrCode: Scan this QR code with your Matter controller (Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, etc.) to add this bridge to another ecosystem.
bridge.appleHomeWarning: This bridge uses Extended Flat mode. Only disable this if you exclusively use Apple Home.
bridge.googleHomeWarning: This may cause issues with Apple Home and Google Home.
bridge.confirmResetMessage: This will remove all pairing information and reset the bridge to its initial state. Connected controllers will lose access. This cannot be undone.
bridge.confirmDeleteMessage: This will permanently delete the bridge, all its pairings, and entity mappings. Connected controllers will lose access. This cannot be undone.
bridge.orphanDescription: Entities removed from Home Assistant more than 7 days ago leave behind stored identity and mapping records. Select the ones to remove.
bridge.orphanEmpty: No orphaned records to clean up.
bridge.importParseFailed: Failed to parse import file. Please select a valid export file.

health.controllerWarningsTitle: Some devices may not show up in a connected controller:

mapping.title: Entity Mappings
mapping.saved: Mapping saved for {{entityId}}. Restart the bridge to apply changes.
mapping.customProductNameHelp: Override the product name (model) reported to Matter controllers. Some controllers (e.g. Aqara) display this as the device name.
mapping.customVendorNameHelp: Override the vendor/manufacturer name reported to Matter controllers.
mapping.customSerialNumberHelp: Override the serial number reported to Matter controllers.
mapping.customVendorIdHelp: Override the numeric Matter Vendor ID (e.g. 0x115F for Aqara). Bridge mode only. Range 1..0xFFFE.
mapping.noMappings: No custom entity mappings configured. Use mappings to override Matter device types, set custom names, or disable specific entities.

notFound.title: Page not found

diagnostics.title: Live Diagnostics
diagnostics.noEvents: No events match the current filters.

startup.title: Startup Order
startup.description: Drag and drop bridges to set the startup order. Lower positions start first.
startup.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to the startup order.

areaSetup.title: Area Setup
areaSetup.heading: Area-based Bridge Setup
areaSetup.description: Automatically create one bridge per Home Assistant area. Each bridge will include all supported entities from that area.
areaSetup.noAreas: No areas with supported entities found in Home Assistant. Make sure your devices are assigned to areas in HA.

lockCredentials.title: Lock Credentials
lockCredentials.lockEntityHelperText: The Home Assistant entity ID of the lock
lockCredentials.confirmDeleteMessage: This will permanently delete the PIN credential for {{entity}}. This cannot be undone.

labels.title: Filter Reference
labels.info: Browse all available filter values for your bridge configuration. Click any value to copy it to your clipboard.
labels.labelsHint: Use with filter type "entity_label" or "device_label". You can use either the display name or the label_id.
labels.noLabels: No labels found in Home Assistant. Create labels under Settings > Labels.
labels.areasHint: Use with filter type "area". Areas are also used for automatic room assignment in Matter controllers.
labels.noAreas: No areas found in Home Assistant. Create areas under Settings > Areas.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.description: Create a full backup of your bridges and entity mappings, or restore from a previous backup.
backup.configBackupDesc: Export bridge configurations and entity mappings.
backup.configBackupNote: Bridges will need to be re-commissioned after restore.
backup.fullBackupDesc: Includes Matter identity files (keypairs, fabric credentials).
backup.fullBackupWarning: Preserves commissioning state across restores. DONT SHARE!
backup.restoreDesc: Upload a previously created backup file to restore bridges and configurations.
backup.restartMessage: Bridges have been restored from backup. A restart is required for the changes to take effect.
backup.restartNote: The application will restart and you may need to refresh this page.
backup.noSnapshots: No stored backups yet. Backups are created automatically on shutdown or can be created manually.
backup.confirmRestoreMessage: Are you sure you want to restore from "{{filename}}"? This will overwrite your current configuration.
backup.restoreWarning: All existing bridges and configurations will be overwritten. A restart is required after restore.
backup.confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{filename}}"? This action cannot be undone.
backup.autoBackupDesc: Automatically create a full backup when the application shuts down or restarts.
backup.retentionCountDesc: Number of backups to keep (oldest are deleted automatically)

updateChecker.title: Software Updates
updateChecker.upToDate: You are running the latest version.
updateChecker.notAvailable: Update check not available in this version

bridgeWizard.title: Bridge Setup Wizard
bridgeWizard.invertCoverDescription: Swap open/close direction for covers. Use this if your covers show the wrong position in Matter controllers.
bridgeWizard.includeHiddenDescription: Also expose entities that are marked as hidden in Home Assistant.
bridgeWizard.portAutoAssign: Automatically assigned to next available port
bridgeWizard.bridgeInfoDescription: Give your bridge a name and port.
bridgeWizard.serverModeTooltip: Exposes entities as standalone Matter devices instead of bridged ones, e.g. so robot vacuums work with Apple Home (Siri) and Alexa. The first entity is the primary; more than one device per node is experimental.
bridgeWizard.entityFilterDescription: Configure which entities should be included in this bridge.
bridgeWizard.serverModeEntityHint: Enter exact entity IDs (e.g., vacuum.my_vacuum). The first one is the primary device of the node.
bridgeWizard.templatePreConfigured: Pre-configured by template. Edit in the full editor after creation.
bridgeWizard.wildcardHint: Use * for all, or patterns like light.*, switch.*
bridgeWizard.commaHint: Enter specific entity IDs separated by commas
bridgeWizard.templateDescription: Choose a template to get started quickly, or skip to create a custom bridge.
bridgeWizard.controllerDescription: Which Matter controller will you use? This optimizes feature flags for your controller.
bridgeWizard.controllerHint: You can always adjust feature flags in the next steps or after bridge creation.
bridgeWizard.templateApplied: Template "{{name}}" applied. Customize the name and port below.
bridgeWizard.filterPreConfiguredFrom: Filter is pre-configured from the "{{name}}" template. You can adjust it below.
bridgeWizard.featureFlagsDescription: Feature flags control how devices are exposed to Matter controllers.
bridgeWizard.selectFlags: Select the flags that match your setup.
bridgeWizard.bridgesCreated: {{count}} bridge(s) already created in this session
